entries.E: Driving the initiative that includes stakeholder buy-in, supporting the team on strategy, planning, solutioning, reviews, and setting directions to show an impact by design. Will target at least 4 major journeys for the 5X transformation for this year 2024-25 Q1 - Key Result 1 - Lab journey: Design strategy & directions with solution concepts and prototyping. Key Result 2 - Identify 3-4 additional journeys that require 5X transformation which would significantly enhance user experience by the end of Q4 Q2 - Key Result 1 - Lab journey: Detailed Design for both UX & UI Key Result 2 - Initiate 2-3 more 5X of Journeys (to be identified): Design strategy & directions with solution concepts and prototyping. Q3 - Key Result 1 - Lab journey: achieving UX success score - SUS - #% or CSAT #% Key Result 2 - 5X journeys (to be identified): Detailed Design for both UX & UI. Q4 - Key Result 1 - 5X journeys: Show UX success - SUS - #% or CSAT #% Key Result 2 - 5X journeys (to be identified): Detailed Design for both UX & UI.
entries.H: Driving the initiative to set the processes and methods for design and project management and building a repository of reusable assets to make the design operations efficient. Q1 - Key Result 1 - Prepare a first cut of the customizable design process with a bare minimum step, in line with a user-centric approach with key deliverables Key Result 2 - Introduce a central repository for knowledge storage. Q2 - Key Result 1 - Finalize the design process with defined guidelines and structure. Conduct 2-3 design process sessions Key Result 2 - Have all the templates, references, and reusable assets (data / images / icons / references, reports, guidelines) published on central repository for access by the team Q3 - Key Result 1 - to be identified Key Result 2 - to be identified Q4 - Key Result 1 - to be identified Key Result 2 - to be identified
